**Static class** in the `Microsoft.Extensions.DependencyInjection` namespace, from the [Latiprimere](/docs/reference/#latiprimere) package.

```csharp
public static class LatiprimereServiceCollectionExtensions
```

Registers Latiprimere services with a dependency injection container.

## Methods

### AddLatiprimere

```csharp
public static IServiceCollection AddLatiprimere(this IServiceCollection services)
```

Registers the Latiprimere printer catalog. Register at least one platform adapter as well, or the catalog will report that no print system is available.

**Parameters**

- `services`: The service collection to add to.

**Returns**

The same service collection, for chaining.

**Exceptions**

- [ArgumentNullException](https://learn.microsoft.com/dotnet/api/system.argumentnullexception): `services` is `null`.
